description: A type as the pack writes it (format 1, OBJ frame) -> what the engine holds of it, in the model frame (stock.WagonTypeParser.parse: markup turned, defaults filled in, geometry checked): error (a finding, or null), warnings (findings), type (length, bogies, mass_t, max_speed_kmh, resistance, traction, cab seats {at, yaw, faces_back}, brakes, interior {zones [minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ], floor_y}, doors {id, box, flags, group, external, axis, outward, inner_face, outer_face, span}, couplers {front, rear, reach [front, rear]}, hull, powered, drivable, boardable, doors_only, wheelbase, leaf_doors), and answers to the questions, asked in the model frame: door_holding [[x, y, z]] (WagonType.doorHolding), doors_worked_by [group] and doors_opened_with [index] (open-door bits), door_open [[mask, index]] (Door.open), floor_at [[x, z]] (Interior.floorAt, margin 0.3), clamp_feet [[x, y, z]] (Interior.clampFeet with the doors and input.open). The loader's findings have only their text yet.
